Comment: glassbox-engagement: orchestrates exactly two opaque AgentCore Runtime invocations around one human .waitForTaskToken approval pause. The microVM's own lifecycle gate remains authoritative; this state machine has no transition table and no lifecycle-state names.

InvokeAgentRuntimeThroughGrade.Comment: Stage 1 - invoke the Runtime and pass an opaque stage hint; this task does not gate or interpret lifecycle transitions.

AwaitHumanApproval.Comment: Stage 2 - zero compute while waiting. fx-gate-hardening: this no longer publishes SNS directly (sns:publish.waitForTaskToken) -- it invokes ApprovalPendingRecorderFunction, which persists {taskToken, targetDomain, gradeResult} to the S3 approvals/pending/ prefix (a prefix the AgentCore Runtime's own execution role has NO access to at all) and publishes the identical human-facing SNS notification itself. The state stays paused until a named human's own approval action (invoking the separate glassbox-approval-writer Lambda, which itself calls SendTaskSuccess) or a direct SendTaskFailure resolves this task's token, or HumanApprovalTimeoutSeconds elapses -- the causal write is now attributable to a real, separately-IAM-scoped approval action rather than a bare 'someone called SendTaskSuccess'.

ExportToSecurityHub.Comment: ARCHITECTURAL FIX (Eric-approved) - runs ONLY after AwaitHumanApproval resolves, i.e. only after ApprovalWriterFunction has already written the HMAC-signed approval artifact and called SendTaskSuccess. Invokes ExportSecurityHubFunction (its OWN dedicated IAM role -- GlassboxAgentRuntimeExecutionRole, the model's role, neither assumes it nor holds securityhub:BatchImportFindings at all), which reads ONLY the GRADE-time WORM freeze object keyed by $.gradeResult.grade_verdict_hash (mcp/lib/grade-freeze-store.js, written by writeGradeVerdict BEFORE any approval existed) -- never live EFS session state, never claims.jsonl, never a re-run bob_finalize_report snapshot. Runs BEFORE ResumeAgentRuntimeThroughReport (the REPORT-stage runtime invocation that composes report.md): export depends only on grade_verdict_hash + the pre-written WORM evidence, not on the eventual report.md. A rejected/failed export fails this state (visible via CloudTrail/console) but the caveat below governs whether that also blocks REPORT -- see Retry: it does NOT retry into ResumeAgentRuntimeThroughReport on failure, this state's own failure propagates to the whole execution.

ResumeAgentRuntimeThroughReport.Comment: Stage 3 - resume the Runtime; this task does not bypass or replicate the microVM gate. Note: infra/runner/agentcore-entrypoint.py no longer reads any approvalToken/approval field from the Payload (fx-gate-hardening removed that model-writable-artifact producer entirely) -- the resumed session's own internal GRADE->REPORT gate (mcp/lib/lifecycle-gates.js gradeToReportApprovalBlocker, .claude/hooks/bob-approval-gate-impl.py) independently verifies the HMAC-bound S3 artifact ApprovalWriterFunction wrote, so nothing from $.approval needs to be threaded into this Payload at all.
